verdict.rationale: Sierra's Explorer product explicitly clusters and analyzes conversations for trends, automatically delivering weekly briefings on 'key trends, emerging issues, and recommendations' without being asked, and Insights lets leaders click into any trend for root-cause investigation — directly matching the story's core ask. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the topic-clustering accuracy or a documented case of catching an issue before ticket spikes, and no detail on how 'emerging' issues are algorithmically distinguished from steady-state topics.
